title: carex paradoxa subsp. teretiuscula
intro: Carex paradoxa subsp. teretiuscula, commonly known as Tufted Sedge, is a species of flowering plant in the family Cyperaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include the potential health benefits of reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Carex paradoxa subsp. teretiuscula include its diuretic and anti-inflammatory effects, which may also help to soothe digestive issues. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its potential health benefits.
